nodes.label: Parity Checklist and Logic Extraction Map
nodes.source_location: UI Rebuild: Parity Checklist and Logic Extraction Map
nodes.rationale: Baseline git tag is legacy-ui-v1 and the working branch is rebuild/ui-v2. Generated from a static scan of apps/mobile imports and hook counts. Each row is meant to be confirmed by reading the screen in Phase 1.

nodes.label: legacy-ui-v1
nodes.source_location: UI Rebuild: Parity Checklist and Logic Extraction Map
nodes.rationale: Git tag that freezes the previous mobile UI. The rebuild uses it as the parity baseline, and one open question is whether a hotfix build from this tag is the only place the old UI must stay reachable.

nodes.label: rebuild/ui-v2
nodes.source_location: UI Rebuild: Parity Checklist and Logic Extraction Map
nodes.rationale: Working branch for the UI rebuild. Screens on this branch are supposed to become thin composition over extracted hooks.

nodes.label: Merchant POS UI
nodes.rationale: Dead code. components/merchant (13 files plus MerchantPosScanner) and MerchantBottomNavBar are 24-line placeholders that nothing imports. UserMode includes merchant in AuthContext, but no screen uses it. ScanTab.tsx is a simulation alert. Still undecided: drop merchant for v2, or design it as a new feature.

nodes.label: Unused mobile component stubs
nodes.rationale: Only 12 components are used by screens: ConnectionWatcher, ErrorModal, OfflineSuccessModal, AppButton, OfflineNoticeModal, CountryCodePicker, BottomNavBar, AppPinInput, BalanceCard, DepositButton, DashboardHeader, and TransactionList. Every other component is an unused stub and can be deleted.

nodes.label: Screen-to-hook extraction
nodes.rationale: Screens call db, services, and apiFetch directly, so there is no hook layer. Logic has to be extracted in Phase 1 before the UI is deleted. Logic stays in services/, db/, and utils/. Each new hook returns state and actions with no JSX, and v2 screens become thin composition.

nodes.label: useOnboarding
nodes.rationale: Highest-risk extraction because it is wallet creation. OnboardingScreen is 1450 lines with 23 useState and touches the accounts API, deviceKeyStore, offlineKeySync, recipientRegistrySync, SEP-10, trustline, mnemonic, secure clipboard, and migration. Split into usePhoneStep, useMnemonicStep, usePinStep, and useRegistration. Keep step order and the secure-screen flag. RestoreWalletScreen shares those steps and should merge into a useWalletSetup core. Mnemonic copy must use a secure clipboard that auto-clears.

nodes.label: SEP-10
nodes.rationale: Stellar authentication step used while creating, restoring, and signing into the wallet, alongside trustline setup.

nodes.label: useLoadFunds
nodes.rationale: LoadOfflineFundsScreen (1081 lines) and LoadOnlineFundsScreen (1062 lines) both import apiFetch and fetchWithTimeout and likely share most logic. Target one hook parameterized by mode, and diff the screens first. Online load is a SEP-24 deposit in a webview; offline load moves funds to the vault.

nodes.label: useSep24Session
nodes.rationale: Sep24WebviewScreen is 977 lines. It runs the anchor webview and injects or uses the main wallet secret, so it needs a careful review. HomeTab also touches the main wallet secret through ensureTrustline.

nodes.label: Production-screen debug code
nodes.rationale: Debug code is inside production screens. DashboardScreen enqueues a mock payload, and exposes clearPaymentQueue, clearTransactions, and correctLegacyTags. debugSmsSend is in ScanQRScreen and TransportChoiceScreen. Gate these behind __DEV__ or drop them in v2.

nodes.label: v2 device parity checklist
nodes.source_location: Parity checklist (each box ticked in v2 on a real device)
nodes.rationale: Acceptance checks to tick on a real device: onboarding and wallet, dashboard (online and offline vault balance, top-up only when EXPO_PUBLIC_TOPUP_ENABLED is true, connection watcher), payments (online send, offline signed queue, QR or SMS transport), funds, settings and compliance including privacy and delete account, and platform behavior. Platform includes the Android back button, softwareKeyboardLayoutMode pan so the keyboard does not cover inputs, safe areas, large font scale, a cold start on a low-end Android release build, and iOS camera, photo-library, and SMS permission strings.

nodes.label: UI rebuild open decisions
nodes.rationale: Three decisions were still open when the map was written: drop merchant mode for v2 or design it; whether NotificationsTab and ScanTab are real features or mocks; and whether the old UI must stay reachable only as a hotfix build from legacy-ui-v1.

nodes.label: Mobile test gap
nodes.rationale: Backend tests live in apps/backend/scripts (e2e-live-test.ts, test-demo scripts, test-sms-webhook.ts, and verify scripts). They cover the server, not the mobile logic. Mobile has no tests. The online-versus-offline send confirm branch is called out as needing tests.
